name: Jack Harrop
features: fair skin, fair hair swept back, light eyes, square open face, strong jaw, athletic build, breezy confident expression
bio: Won the 1937 RAC Rally outright in an SS Jaguar 100 through the worst snow the event has ever seen, having already taken the Royal Scottish trophy on that year’s Monte Carlo for the best runner out of John o’ Groats. The factory signed him afterwards and he won the RAC again in 1938 and finished tenth on the 1939 Monte. He flew fighters in the war and failed to return from a patrol in 1941.
